### 14.2 Severability  
If any term is found invalid, the remaining terms remain in effect.

raw_entities.name: Severability Clause
raw_entities.description: A contractual provision stating that if any term of the agreement is found to be invalid or unenforceable, the remaining terms continue to remain in full effect and are not affected by the invalidity of any single provision.
